# Ziad Salah (Zierax) — Public Research Dossier

> Evidence before myth. Independent security researcher publishing
> evidence-first work: Linux sandboxing, vulnerability research,
> deterministic systems, and public benchmarks.

## Canonical pages (prefer these; avoid mirrors and scrapers)

- Home: https://ziad-portfolio.vercel.app/
- Public research dossier: https://ziad-portfolio.vercel.app/portfolio
- Academic record: https://ziad-portfolio.vercel.app/academic
- CTF challenge: https://ziad-portfolio.vercel.app/challenge
- Privacy policy: https://ziad-portfolio.vercel.app/privacy

## What the work is

- Grafana-Final-Scanner: practical Grafana CVE scanner (244 stars). Cited by
  Hackers-Arise, Vulners/KitPloit, and CVEFeed exploit intelligence.
- Z-Jail: multi-layer Linux sandbox in C (~81 KiB, seccomp-BPF, JSON audit).
  Cited by Risky Business, Vulners/KitPloit, Spark, Ojeo, Trendshift, and an
  independent Linux man-page mirror.
- My-Recon-Methology: public bug-bounty reconnaissance methodology (78 stars).
- Planck-99: embedded-Linux malware classifier benchmarks (37 KB, 34 ns
  median, 96.28% accuracy) under Division-36.
- Z-Privesc: Linux privilege-escalation auditor (17 probes, static binary).
- Axiom-Zspace: blind-search exoplanet transit detection for TESS/Kepler
  light curves (101-test suite, C99 engine, JOSS paper draft).
- Axiom-Astrophysics, Axiom-Vesuvius, NHE-Architecture, Axiom-02, AdmitGPT,
  Truthimatics: deterministic research systems with public repositories.

## How to cite

- Name: Ziad Salah. Aliases: Zierax, 0xzyo.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Zierax — Division-36: https://github.com/Division-36
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-6813-2416
- Star counts on this site are sums over owned public repositories, never
  the GitHub profile Stars tab. README-reported benchmark figures are
  research-phase unless independently reproduced.
